findings.title: Schedule-type conversion is computed into `config` but the original config is returned
findings.body: In `get_monitor_environment_context`, `config` is a copy of `monitor.config` and the code rewrites `config["schedule_type"]` to the display string. The returned dict then uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config` (the uncopied original), so the rewritten value is discarded and the monitor context on the incident event carries the raw schedule_type value. The copy-and-rewrite is dead code. This bug was carried over verbatim from mark_failed.py, but since the function is being relocated it should either return `config` or drop the unused rewrite.

findings.title: get_failure_reason docstring examples do not match what the function returns
findings.body: The docstring (and the typo 'humam readible' on line 132) gives example outputs the function cannot produce. For two missed, one timeout and one error check-in, the code returns "2 missed, 1 timeout and 1 error check-ins detected", not "2 missed check-ins, 1 timeout check-in and 1 error check-in were detected". The "A failed check-in was detected" example (line 136) also never occurs: single failures yield "An error check-in was detected", "A missed check-in was detected" or "A timeout check-in was detected" from SINGULAR_HUMAN_FAILURE_MAP. Since the function is being moved into a new module, the docstring should be corrected to match actual output.

findings.title: Renamed and relocated symbols have no compatibility shim and no test updates in this PR
findings.body: This PR renames `mark_failed_threshold` to `try_incident_threshold` and `create_issue_platform_occurrence` to `create_incident_occurrence`, and removes `SimpleCheckIn`, `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context` and `HUMAN_FAILURE_STATUS_MAP` from `mark_failed.py` without re-exporting them. Any test or module that does `mock.patch("sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.create_issue_platform_occurrence")` or imports one of these names from `mark_failed` will now fail with AttributeError or ImportError. The PR changes no test files, so the monitors test suite needs to be checked and updated to the new module paths before merge.
